text:
Priya: quick triage — need a compact MVP cut matrix for Monday exec review. We have to pick which feature pathways to keep vs defer, and decide if we shift milestone by 2 weeks.
Sam: timeline? is that the public launch milestone or internal v1 target?
Priya: public launch slice. v1 can carry more. Exec wants a clear minimal path that preserves core SLAs.
Ravi: ok. main levers: hosted API (must), console (min viable), dedicated pools (defer?), Optimize toolkit (defer), Private deploy (defer), telemetry retention (reduce), SSO (defer to v1?).
Marta: design POV — preserve onboarding flow and basic console flows. Everything else can be behind a "beta" flag.
Jordan: SRE flag: if we defer dedicated pools we need fallback routing to keep latency SLOs under load. That adds ops work.
Sam: +1. tradeoff table might help. quick matrix from my notes:
```
Cut Matrix (MVP vs v1) — short form
Feature                    | MVP (keep/defer) | Risk bucket | Notes
-------------------------- | ----------------- | ----------- | --------------------------
Hosted API                 | keep              | low         | core product surface
Console (basic)            | keep              | low-med     | onboarding + route debug
Console: observability UX  | defer             | med         | can be beta after launch
Dedicated pools            | defer             | med-high    | affects throughput predictability
Private deploy (VPC/onprem)| defer             | high        | sales blocker for some ent.
Optimize toolkit           | defer             | med         | cost controls for heavy users
SSO / Enterprise auth      | defer             | high        | blockers for pilots
Telemetry retention (90d)  | reduce to 30d     | low-med     | reduces infra cost
Rollouts/canary UI         | keep (basic)      | med         | critical for safe deploys
```
Priya: thanks — this format is good. We need clear asks for sales (who asked for private deploy). Can someone list top 3 pilot accounts that would be blocked by deferring private deploy?
Sam: I'll DM the list to @Priya — two are non-negotiable, one is negotiable if we give a patch timeline.
Ravi: ops estimate for fallback routing if dedicated pools deferred: ~3 engineer-weeks + testing.
Jordan: and we should add a contingency: if latency > 250ms p95 for 3 consecutive hours, auto-fallback to a lower-cost model variant. I can draft the policy.
Marta: UX decision: mark deferred features in console as "coming in v1" with request access CTA. reduces churn.
Priya: decision proposal for Monday: 1) Ship Hosted API + basic console + rollouts; 2) Defer Dedicated, Private, and Optimize toolkit to v1; 3) Reduce telemetry retention to 30d for MVP; 4) Add fallback routing + auto-degrade policy (Jordan to own). Also list two pilot accounts that need special handling.
Sam: :thumbsup: agree with proposal.
Ravi: I'll add the ops estimate to the milestone ticket and flag the 3w work.
Jordan: drafting fallback playbook now, will post link when ready.
deploy-bot: Deploy check for branch "release/mvp-slice" — CI passed, no blocking tests (build #4821)
Priya: great — please add final matrix + owner rows to the milestone doc. We need this in exec packet by EOD Monday.
Sam: will do. tagging @Marta for the UX blurbs.
Marta: on it. will push microcopy + CTA by tomorrow morning.
Priya: thanks team. if any blockers surface, ping here.
